_note: Target sizes for HPUK SharePoint News post images. 'basis' says where each size comes from: 'Microsoft' sizes follow Microsoft's published SharePoint image guidance; 'HPUK good practice' sizes are this skill's working standard until the HPUK Brand Centre or News publishing guidance sets one. Change a size here, not in the script.

news-banner.label: SharePoint News banner / page title image
news-banner.basis: Microsoft (16:9 title area, also used as the News thumbnail)

news-thumbnail.label: News thumbnail (when different from the banner)

supporting-image.label: Picture in the body of a News post (Image web part)
